title: Replicating 'A Few Bad Neurons' on a Different Misalignment Benchmark: PHIL vs. POLI

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful chain: if domain-specific sycophancy requires domain-specific neuron correction, monitoring and correction must be per-domain. However, the practical implication is relatively narrow (POLI vs. PHIL overlap) and the safety impact is incremental.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: Jaccard overlap of neuron sets between POLI and PHIL. But the prerequisite of running the full pipeline twice doubles the work compared to a single run.
